article.label: Feature article
article.purpose: Explain a topic so a busy professional understands why it matters and what changes
structure: A hook paragraph that frames why the topic matters now
Three or four H2 sections that build understanding step by step
A section on practical implications for the reader
A short closing section with one memorable takeaway
article.tone: Informative, clear and confident, without hype
rules: Explain any jargon the first time it appears
visual_affinity: cinematic still with shallow depth of field

guide.label: How-to guide
guide.purpose: Help the reader complete a task or launch an initiative successfully
structure: A short intro on who this is for and what they will achieve
A 'Before you start' H2 listing prerequisites
Five to seven steps, each as an H2 titled 'Step N: ...'
A 'Common pitfalls' H2
A short checklist to finish
rules: Every step starts with an action verb
Keep each step specific enough to act on today

opinion.label: Opinion piece
opinion.purpose: Argue for a clear position and persuade a skeptical reader
structure: State the thesis plainly in the first paragraph
Three H2 sections, each making one supporting argument
An H2 that presents the strongest counterargument and rebuts it
A closing call to action
opinion.tone: Persuasive and confident but fair, first person plural
rules: Take a side; avoid both-sides hedging in the thesis

trend_analysis.label: Trend analysis
trend_analysis.purpose: Explain where a trend stands, what drives it and what to watch next
structure: An H2 on where things stand today
An H2 on the three main drivers behind the trend
An H2 on implications for different stakeholders
An H2 on what to watch over the next 12 to 24 months
A short bottom-line section
trend_analysis.tone: Analytical and measured, with hedged forecasts
rules: Do not invent statistics, dates, quotes or company claims; describe magnitude qualitatively unless it is widely known
Separate what is happening from what might happen
visual_affinity: cinematic still with shallow depth of field

listicle.label: Listicle
listicle.purpose: Give a skimmable set of distinct, useful ideas
structure: A two- or three-sentence intro that promises the list
Five to seven numbered H2 items such as '## 1. ...', each with a bold one-line takeaway and two or three supporting sentences
A short wrap-up
rules: Every item must be distinct; no padding items
Lead each item with the takeaway, not the setup

angles.text: A primer that builds understanding from first principles for newcomers
A contrarian take that challenges a popular assumption
Told through the customer's journey, step by step
Behind the scenes: how operations and teams actually change
Through the lens of cost, ROI and business outcomes
Future-looking: what changes over the next few years
Risks, trade-offs and how to manage them
How we got here, and what that history teaches
A playbook of concrete moves a team can make this quarter

hooks.text: Open with a short, vivid scenario
Open with a bold but defensible claim
Open by contrasting the old way with the new way
Open with a two-sentence story about one person

audiences.text: practitioners who do the work every day
newcomers who know little about the topic
customers who feel the effects first-hand
leaders planning for the next three years

visual_styles: cinematic still with shallow depth of field
minimal line art with a single accent color
compositions: rule-of-thirds framing with generous negative space
palettes: warm sunset oranges against deep blues
monochrome with one vivid accent color
